QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] Meet Hiver 2
QuestInfo.0: #p1013203# must be a high-ranking member of the Black Wings if he's that hard to get ahold of. See if #p2152016# knows how to meet up with him.
QuestInfo.1: #p2152016# offered to contact #p1013203# for you, but he wants you to eliminate some #o4230105#s and bring him a heaping helping of #t2022039#. How much can this guy eat?!
QuestInfo.2: #p2152016# took the #t2022039# and told you he'd received #p1013203#'s response.

0.0: Oh, did you think I was going to do that for free? No, no, no. I need payment! Have you seen the #o7150002#s inside #b#m200000000##k? I've heard their meat is quite tasty. Bring me some #b#t2022039##k from the #o4230105#s and I'll get ahold of #p1013203# while you're away.

yes.0: Mmm, my mouth is watering already. #t2022039# is pretty rare, so I'd think you'll need to hunt about 50 to 70 monsters before you get one. Goooooooood luck!

no.0: So you don't need to talk to #p1013203#? That's fine. It makes no difference to me!

1.0: Whoa, lookit that #t2022039#! Let me get a taste...

yes.0: *nom* *nom* *nom* Oh, it's so sweet. ...Right, so, you still want to meet with #p1013203#?

item.0: Where is my #b#t2022039##k? No #b#t2022039##k, no response from #p1013203#!
